title: Hateshinaki Scarlet

alternative_titles.ja: 果てしなきスカーレット

synopsis:
As the sole daughter of the late king of Denmark, princess Scarlet took it upon herself to enact revenge against those who betrayed her father. All her efforts, however, come to naught when her enemies move first and deliver a fatal blow to the princess.

Still, her quest for revenge is far from over. After waking up in the desolate "Land of the Dead," Scarlet realizes that she still has another chance of punishing those responsible for her family's tragedy. Now accompanied by Hijiri, a peculiar young man from a faraway land, the bloodthirsty princess sets off on her renewed hunt for those who wronged her. But the journey through the underworld is perilous, and the answers Scarlet seeks might come from the most unexpected of places.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
